reason: The source-reviewed member journey supports observations, explicit not-observed ratings, readiness checks, review before locking, and receipt-based confirmation. A 409 correctly remains unconfirmed and directs the evaluator to My work, whose server-derived status distinguishes locked work. Group Case Board summaries clearly separate saved partial observations from valid independent evaluations. Supplied desktop/mobile hero captures show coherent Precision Instrument hierarchy and distinct audience actions. Public copy acknowledges pending client approval; applicant copy accurately discloses original-resume access. However, evaluator draft recovery can erase newer unsynced evidence, and backup assurances exceed confirmed storage state. These defects prevent agreement and warrant holding this workflow. This is a simulated AI member lens, source/log/capture review, not observed user success or hosted acceptance.

findings.evidence: loadDraft always chooses a valid server draft over the browser copy. The subsequent writeEvaluationDraft effect writes those recovered values back to browser storage. Scenario: save A to server, edit B while server saves fail, reload after connectivity returns; server A wins and overwrites browser B without comparison or choice.
findings.userImpact: An evaluator can lose newer ratings and observable evidence precisely while recovering from a save outage.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve differing browser/server drafts, compare a confirmed revision or saved signature, and offer an explicit recovery choice before overwriting either copy. Add an outage/edit/reload regression.

findings.evidence: The form ignores writeEvaluationDraft’s boolean result, yet save-error copy says "Your browser backup is current"; load-error copy at line 157 also promises a backup. src/lib/evaluation-draft-recovery.ts:177-182 returns false for oversized snapshots or storage failures.
findings.userImpact: With unavailable/quota-limited storage and a server failure, the reviewer may leave believing evidence is recoverable when neither copy was saved.
findings.suggestedFix: Track backup-write success and show an honest unsaved warning with keep-open/copy guidance when both persistence paths fail; cover storage-denied and quota failures.
